Home.comingSoon: Trips and patients arrive in the next phase.

Errors.signedOut: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
Errors.forbidden: You don't have access to that.
Errors.conflict: This record changed since you opened it. Reload and try again.
Errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
Errors.internal: Something went wrong. Please try again.
Errors.resetCodeInvalid: That code is wrong, used, or expired. Ask an admin for a new one.
Errors.doctorDomain: Doctors must register with their HFSO email address.
Errors.tooShort: Use at least 12 characters. A few words together works well.
Errors.common: That password is too common or easy to guess.
Errors.containsEmail: Don't use your email name in the password.

Register.title: Register
Register.intro: An admin must approve your account before you can use the system.
Register.doctorHint: Doctors must use their HFSO email.
Register.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.

Pending.title: Account not active yet
Pending.pending: Your account is waiting for an admin to approve it. Ask a trip admin to approve you, then sign in again.
Pending.disabled: Your account is disabled. Ask an admin if you think this is a mistake.
Pending.registered: Thanks for registering. An admin must approve your account before you can sign in.

Reset.title: Reset your password
Reset.intro: Ask an admin for a reset code. It works once, for 30 minutes.
Reset.done: Your password has been changed and all your devices were signed out. Sign in with your new password.

Account.title: Your account
Account.changePasswordHint: Your other devices will be signed out.
Account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.
Account.devicesHint: Sign out any device you don't recognise or no longer use.
